atoms.text: Class 5P visited a farm that had many animals, including chickens. This bar chart shows how many chickens are each age.

atoms.a: Which of these bar charts shows that there are four chickens that are four years old?
Which bar chart shows that there are 10 chickens older than 5 years old?

atoms.text: The farm also weighed their chickens rounded to the nearest 0.2 kg. This bar chart shows the data they collected.
atoms.sound: The farm also weighed their chickens rounded to the nearest 0.2 kilograms. This bar chart shows the data they collected.

instruction.text: Listen to the statements and pick the one that is true.

b.sound: There are two chickens that weigh less than 0.4 kilograms.
There is one chicken that weighs less than 0.4 kilograms.
All but one chicken weighs less than 1.6 kilograms.
All but one chicken weighs less than 1 kilogram.
There are five chickens that weigh 0.6 kilograms.
There are four chickens that weigh 0.6 kilograms.
